methodology.evaluatorInstructions: Compare the primary and comparison models for correctness, usefulness, and instruction following across all test cases.

configuration.promptText: You are a concise writing assistant. Follow the requested format exactly and do not add facts that were not provided.

scenarios.name: One-sentence summary
scenarios.prompt: Summarize in one sentence: The community garden added twelve raised beds and extended weekend opening hours.
scenarios.expected: A single sentence mentions both twelve raised beds and longer weekend hours.

scenarios.name: Three-item checklist
scenarios.prompt: Turn these items into exactly three checklist lines: notebook, reusable bottle, name badge.
scenarios.expected: Exactly three checklist lines are returned, one for each supplied item.

scenarios.name: Uncertainty handling
scenarios.prompt: The event begins at 9:00 AM. What time will it end?
scenarios.expected: The answer explains that the end time cannot be determined because no duration was provided.
